propositions: A symbolic --ref is resolved multiple times during close (verify and sign), allowing origin/main to advance mid-operation and create a mismatch between the verified sha and the signed sha
When verification passes against one commit but the signer refuses a later commit due to drift, the close succeeds with status=closed but silently omits the completion-verifier signature
The close gate lacks observable output indicating when an attestation is missing or when verified and signed shas diverge, leaving silent failures indistinguishable from unverified closes

Resolving the symbolic ref once at the close boundary and replacing the original argument ensures verification, snapshot materialization, drift guard, and signing all operate against the same immutable commit
